sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Airport Bonded In-Flight Meal Production and Direct Ramp Delivery

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (unitary national system; codified commercial law in the Code de commerce)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 26 November 2007; in force 20 September 2010)
France–China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (1984; amended by Protocol of 26 November 2013)
France–Hong Kong Double Taxation Agreement (2010; in force 2011)
EU–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (in force 1 February 2019)
ICSID Convention (France is a Contracting State; independent BIT arbitration available under active French BITs)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF) Arts. L.561-1 to L.561-50, L.561-2-1, L.561-5, L.561-10 and R.561-1 et seq.; Décret n° 2016-1636 of 29 November 2016 on the register of beneficial owners (RBE); Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on information accompanying transfers of funds; FATF Recommendations 10, 24 and 25; EU and French asset-freeze regulations and ministerial arrêtés de gel des avoirs; ACPR and Tracfin supervisory guidance; the transfer of the RBE to INPI effective from 1 January 2023.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (post-CJEU C-37/20 restrictive framework: the RBE is not fully public; access is limited to French competent authorities and to AML/CFT-obliged entities acting within a legitimate-interest due diligence mandate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (alternative: Consular Legalization if the issuing state is not a party to the 1961 Hague Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of the passport of each proposed gérant (manager) and each direct shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague issuing states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and proof of lawful source of funds for the capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization paired with Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization where applicable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney authorizing incorporation and representation before the INPI Guichet Unique
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague issuing states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of no criminal record (or equivalent good conduct certificate) of the designated gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent criminal-record authority of the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization where applicable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Parent-company board resolution approving the SARL incorporation and appointment of the gérant, accompanied by an overseas legal opinion
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed law firm of the parent's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization paired with Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague issuing states)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Pre-capitalization and pre-filing mandatory screening must cover all corporate shareholders, the designated gérant, beneficial owners and, where known, the aviation contract counterparties. Mandatory screening sources: (1) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions File (FTS); (2) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (3) French asset-freeze ministerial orders (arrêtés de gel des avoirs); (4) notices of the Direction générale du Trésor; (5) OFAC SDN List, given USD clearing and international aviation supply-chain exposure; (6) FATF high-risk jurisdiction and countermeasures lists. Politically Exposed Persons (CMF Art. L.561-10 and R.561-16) and their family members/close associates trigger enhanced due diligence, including independent verification of the lawful origin of the contributed capital; any positive hit must be escalated to the compliance officer and may require a declaration of suspicion to Tracfin before the RCS filing. Audit trails must be retained for five years (CMF Art. L.561-5).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI 'Guichet Unique' (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr / guichetunique.inpi.fr) with RCS name-availability verification through Infogreffe (infogreffe.fr) and the INPI trademark database (data.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate statutes and registry filings must be in French (Constitution, Art. 2; Loi Toubon n° 94-665 of 4 August 1994, Arts. 2 and 5). Names in a non-Latin script or foreign language may be used as a trade name but must be accompanied by a French-language transliteration in the RCS application; the legal form suffix 'SARL' must appear in all corporate acts (C.com Arts. L.223-1 and R.123-53).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Regulated financial tokens requiring ACPR authorization: 'Banque', 'Crédit', 'Finance', 'Assurance', 'Mutuelle', 'Courtier', 'Société de financement'
Tokens reserved to public authorities or contrary to public order: 'République', 'Police', 'Armée', 'Gendarmerie', 'Préfet', 'Maire', 'Commune', 'Défense nationale'
Regulated profession denominations without prior approval: 'Avocat', 'Notaire', 'Expert-comptable', 'Commissaire aux comptes', 'Huissier'
Misleading references to legal form or listing status: a SARL may not contain 'SA', 'SAS', 'SCA', 'GIE', 'Société cotée' or any equivalent suggesting another form
Existing registered trademarks and notorious marks in identical or similar classes (e.g., airline brands such as 'Air France') unless written consent or coexistence authorization is obtained

Protected or fraud-prone food terms such as 'Halal' and 'Bio'/'Biologique' unless demonstrable certification and compliance with consumer-law requirements (C.conso Art. L.113-1; Regulation (EU) 2018/848) are evidenced
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not operate a statutory name reservation certificate; availability is verified against the RCS and trademark registers at filing. If the greffier refuses registration on unavailability or confusion grounds, a reasoned decision is notified. The applicant may re-file a corrected draft within 15 days through the Guichet Unique; a formal appellate petition may be filed within 15 days of notification with the judge supervising the RCS (juge commis à la surveillance du registre) under C.com Arts. R.123-92 to R.123-94, who may order registration by ordinance. Parallel trademark-conflict claims, if any, are brought before the tribunal judiciaire. Practical 'extension' is immediate: a fresh availability search restarts the 30-day window at no statutory fee.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10, L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL), and Article 1 of Décret n°2021-1413 (Guichet Unique)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) maintained by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, accessed through the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises operated by INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Demande de constitution de société with Annex 0 (Formulaire M0) together with the notarized or privately executed Articles of Association (Statuts)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum SARL capital applies; under Articles L.223-2 and L.223-7 of the French Commercial Code, the capital must be fully subscribed and at least 20% of cash contributions paid in on incorporation. Cash funds are placed in trust in a blocked bank account until the RCS certificate is issued, at which point the funds are released.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by unanimous consent of all partners, that (1) the Articles of Association submitted to this meeting are hereby approved; (2) the proposed share subscriptions, cash contribution schedule, and the paid-up portion equal to twenty percent are accepted; (3) the release of funds from the blocked capital account is authorized only upon issuance of the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés certificate; (4) the registered office is fixed at [address] conditional upon execution of the lease; (5) [Name] is appointed as sole Gérant with the powers set out in the Articles; and (6) the Gérant and any appointed delegate are fully empowered to complete statutory filings, publish the mandatory legal notice, execute all registration procedures, and obtain the sanitary, environmental, and aviation-related operating permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Partners acting through the Guichet Unique; notary optional except for real property contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the French-language Statuts, including per-partner share allocations, intended corporate object encompassing airport in-flight catering, gérant appointment clause, and address of registered office. Each partner must sign every original copy; any contribution in kind must be valued by a commissaire aux apports where permitted by law, except when a simple valuation report is allowed.
required_dossiers: Valid copy of passport or national identity card of every partner
Proof of residential address of each partner
Draft Articles of Association
Bank certificate evidencing the blocked account for the 20% paid-up cash portion
Valuation report of any in-kind contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the draft is challenged during legalization, revise the Statuts and obtain partner signatures de novo; a notarized act may be executed to cure deficiencies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application with the Guichet Unique (INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises, INPI (online portal formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the M0 application and upload the signed Statuts on the Guichet Unique portal. The system electronically transmits the dossier to the competent RCS registry and the relevant tax and social bodies. Registration is evidenced by issuance of the Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Completed form M0
Signed Articles of Association
Blocked capital certificate issued by the bank
Proof of publication of the legal notice (announcement in an approved legal gazette)
Identification and residential proof for each manager (gérant)
Statement of no criminal convictions and company project representation list
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the receiver issues an observation, rectify the dossier through the Guichet Unique within the notified deadline, usually 15 days; if the RCS clerk rejects the application, petition the president of the commercial court for injunctive relief or refile corrected documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the statutory notice in an authorized legal gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Approved legal journal (journal d'annonces légales) in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the constitutional notice containing the corporate form, corporate name, capital, address, object, duration, gérant identity, and RCS city before submission to the Guichet Unique. Retain the publisher's attestation for inclusion in the filing.
required_dossiers: Text of the legal announcement
Payment receipt for publication fees
Publisher's attestation of the publication after insertion
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publication wording is defective, publish a corrective notice and submit a newly dated attestation; retroactive effects cannot be cured but the registry will accept the corrected notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés and issuance of the Kbis
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce through the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of a complete dossier, the RCS registry registers the SARL, records the legal representatives, and issues the Kbis extract, which constitutes the conclusive corporate existence certificate for the company. The Kbis must be held at the registered office and otherwise kept in the company records.
required_dossiers: Incorporation application as processed by Guichet Unique
Attestation of publication in the legal gazette
The signed Statuts
Bank capital block certificate
Declaration of non-conviction for managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis is delayed or refused, request an explanation from the Greffe; supply missing documents or correct inconsistencies, or apply to the role of the commercial court for a forced registration order.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Social and tax authorities: URSSAF, Caisse de Sécurité Sociale, Regional Tax Authority (SIE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Kbis, register the company as employer for payroll, obtain a health insurance and pension account identifier, and declare the corporate tax (IS) elections and VAT status. The professional activities of the gérant must also be registered with the relevant social security body.
required_dossiers: Unofficial Kbis extract
Statutory and leverage details of the gérant
Lease agreement for the registered office
Bank account details (RIB)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If employer registration is held up, write or re-submit through the Guichet Unique after correcting the SIRET/SIREN data; appeal any tax identity mismatch to the competent SIE.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for sanitary approval from the food safety authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Départementale de la Protection des Populations (DDPP) or Direction départementale de l'emploi, la cohésion sociale et de la protection des populations (DDEPP)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the sanitary approval application under Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 and the instruction DGAL/SDSSA for unlicensed food establishments. The business must demonstrate compliance with HACCP and food traceability requirements before commencement of commercial activity. Approval is specific to the risk classification of the food operation and length of storage.
required_dossiers: Food business operator registration form
HACCP plan and hygiene self-monitoring procedures
Transport configuration for chilled and hot in-flight meals
Aerial waste management procedures
Verification of safe water supply and wastewater discharge
Civil defense authorization for use as food-preparation premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If approval is refused, implement and document the corrective measures, resubmit, or appeal to the administrative tribunal after exhausting the remedy of the independent appeals committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental registration as an ICPE and industrial operating clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) and the Prefect of the relevant department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Determine the applicable ICPE (Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement) threshold for the in-flight catering kitchen and file either a declaration or registration dossier with the facility inventory. Obtain the non-objection decision and submit the environmental compliance report for the cooking, refrigeration, and cleaning processes.
required_dossiers: Description of Industrial Activity and Waste Generation
Site plan and environmental risk assessment
CFP and waste disposal contracts
Noise, odour, and wastewater compliance plans
Hydrocarbon removal system description for the catering kitchen
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DREAL issues a challenge, submit supplementary geological, noise, or odour studies and formally request revision; the Prefect may order compliance measures and an administrative appeal is available.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Générale de l'Alimentation (DGAL) / Direction Départementale de la Protection des Populations (DDPP) under the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Agrément sanitaire (sanitary approval) for food business operators establishing an airplane-inflight catering kitchen pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 and Regulation (EU) 2017/625, together with the airport access authorization issued by the airport restricted-area security manager

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique / Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration (Enregistrement) under the French ICPE regime if the kitchen processes animal-derived food above the anthropic thresholds; smaller units are classified as Déclaration. A full EIA report is not normally required for a catering kitchen unless the site falls within an installation class requiring autorisation on the basis of size or discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must meet the thresholds of the ICPE authorization decree; segregated grease traps and pH balancing are required; VOC/odour emissions from cooking areas are controlled by odour-monitoring and carbon-filter maintenance; packaging waste is subject to Extended Producer Responsibility obligations; food-grade waste must be handled in conformance with Regulation (EC) No 1774/2002 and its successors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance issued by the commission de sécurité (or by the Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours, SDIS) for the commercial kitchen, including a structural load certificate for the kitchen equipment; occupational clearance includes air quality and extractor ventilation inspection, electrical installation verification, first-aid and hygiene attestations, and a workplace medical fitness statement for all food-handling staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – impots.gouv.fr; VAT registration via the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) / guichet unique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SARL must be incorporated through the guichet unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), which registers the entity with the RCS (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés) and automatically allocates a SIREN (unique business identifier), SIRET (establishment number), and intra-Community VAT number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire). For a non-established foreign entity undertaking taxable supplies in France, registration is completed by filing Form CA3173 with the SIE, and the foreign entity must appoint an established tax representative when required. The certificate of VAT registration is issued by the DGFiP under Article 286 of the CGI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (Société à Responsabilité Limitée; subject to corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés – IS) on profits. Resident SARLs are taxable on worldwide profits subject to treaty and controlled-foreign-company rules, while non-resident companies are taxed on French-source profits only. The standard IS rate is 25%; reduced rate for small and medium enterprises on profits up to EUR 42,500 applies for qualifying entities.)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style 'check-the-box' election exists in France. A SARL can make a specific statutory election (option pour l'impôt sur le revenu – IR) to be taxed as a pass-through for a five-year period if it qualifies as an SME (e.g., fewer than 50 employees and turnover below EUR 10 million), provided the shareholders are individuals. The option must be notified to the DGFiP before the end of the first accounting period. For hybrid mismatches, mandatory anti-hybrid rules under the EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD) apply without elective opt-in; France does not provide hybrid entity elections. European VAT grouping (assujettis uniques) is available under a non-opposability election with administrative authorization.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée – TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Domestic-established businesses: EUR 85,000 annual turnover threshold for supplies of goods; EUR 37,500 annual turnover threshold for services. For the present SARL operating an airport bonded in-flight meal production facility, VAT registration is mandatory without any threshold because the activity involves continuous commercial production, airport ramp delivery, and import/export-related supplies. Intangible or digital services provided to final consumers may be subject to the EU VAT e-commerce thresholds.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates B2B electronic invoicing in phases: from 1 September 2026 all taxable persons must be able to receive e-invoices; from 1 September 2027 all taxable persons must issue e-invoices through an accredited Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire (PDP) or through the Chorus Pro fiscal portal. Invoices must conform to the EU e-invoicing system (EN 16931) and be transmitted in near-real time for e-reporting of transaction data to DGFiP. There is no real-time fiscal stamping or digital clearance for standard B2B catering supplies; periodic VAT returns (Form CA3) and Intrastat declarations apply. Aircraft provisioning and export-related supplies require full electronic retention of the customs and transport documentation for DGFiP audit access.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies to (i) exports of goods dispatched or transported to a destination outside the EU, provided the exporter establishes proof of transfer of ownership and actual physical departure from the EU within the statutory period, and (ii) supplies of goods for the provisioning, fuelling, or in-flight catering of aircraft operated by airlines engaged in international routes, as derived from Article 148 of the EU VAT Directive and incorporated into French law (Article 262-II of the CGI). Meals prepared in the bonded kitchen and loaded directly onto international aircraft at the ramp quality as these exempt-with-credit supplies. A direct service to the aircraft operator or certificate of shipment to a non-EU airline is required. For intra-community supplies, the 0% rate applies with the customer's valid VAT number and EC reporting.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU via the DELTA/RECAP system or SAD for non-EU exports)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill (AWB) or ramp delivery certificate evidencing loading onto the international aircraft
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or foreign-exchange settlement confirmation (bank SWIFT proof) evidencing payment received from the non-resident airline operator
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP rigorously audits export and aircraft-provisioning zero-rating claims. Insufficient or contradictory customs, transport, and payment documentation results in reassessment of VAT at the standard rate, plus late-payment interest of 0.20% per month (intérêts de retard). Forgery or deliberate misdeclaration triggers professional negligence penalties of 40% (défaillance) or fraud penalties of 80% (manœuvres frauduleuses) of the tax due. Criminal tax fraud conviction can lead to a fine of up to EUR 500,000 and five years' imprisonment for directors and managers. The tax authority may apply retrospective clawback for up to six years and the 10-year statute of limitations for undeclared bank accounts, and may publicize the penalty in certain cases. The taxpayer has the burden of proving the export is real and documents are authentic.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France); prudential and AML supervision by the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR); foreign exchange and international investment monitoring coordinated with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) and the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) for goods-related declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible and France applies the EU Treaty free movement of capital regime (Article 63 TFEU). Current account transactions are unrestricted, and capital account operations comprising capital injections, shareholder loans, dividend distribution and liquidation proceeds are generally free for a SARL. Non-EU/EEA inbound investments are screened under the French foreign direct investment regime (Décret n° 2019-1590) only where protected strategic sectors, license-holder control or public security concerns are triggered; airport bonded in-flight catering is not enumerated as a protected sector, but the operator's customs-bonded status may attract secondary review. Profit remittance hurdles are limited to the 30% single flat withholding tax on dividends (prélèvement forfaitaire unique) unless reduced under an applicable double tax treaty; loan repayment and trade remittances face no exchange-control barrier.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation. A French SARL may lawfully retain export proceeds in foreign currency in a licensed foreign-currency account without mandatory conversion into euros. However, the Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting framework requires the intermediary bank to declare individual cross-border transactions of EUR 50,000 or more per month and, for trade-in-goods, DGDDI requires electronic declaration (déclaration d'échange de biens) above EUR 150,000 per transaction. Supporting export invoices, transport documents, airline delivery logs and customs clearance references must be archived for a minimum of 6 years to evidence lawful receipt and clearance.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank / LCL

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for auxiliary vendor disbursements and card issuance; Low as the sole treasury anchor for aviation-contract settlements and Banque de France reporting. An offshore digital EMI lacking an ACPR licence or a passport under the EU Payment Services Directive (PSD2) cannot lawfully hold material airline receivables or execute bonded catering customs payments; such unregulated PSPs trigger irremediable AML incompatibility with the SARL's Kbis-regulated banking identity. ACPR-licensed or properly passported European EMIs may support daily disbursements and expense control, but must be supplemented by a commercial bank to provide TARGET2/SEPA settling membership, customs duty payments and statutory cross-border reporting.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French commercial banks traditionally require a physical branch meeting with the gérant (manager) or a board-designated authorised signatory for initial onboarding of a corporate SARL; fully remote opening is only available through ACPR-regulated digital banks for low-risk profiles or where the bank already holds an existing group relationship. For a SARL with non-EU shareholders, the standard practice is a physical interview, original or notarially certified corporate documents, and an authenticated passport check; remote videoconference KYC is accepted only as a supplement, not a substitute.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) opacity where non-EU shareholders are not disclosed to the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Kbis extract; notarised statuts (articles of association); full share register evidencing the ownership chain; passport and proof of residence of each UBO; signed sanctions and PEP self-certification; notarised power of attorney where the manager signs remotely.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for capital injection or escrow transfer from a foreign parent without a documented funds trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share subscription minutes and board resolution; certificate of deposit issued by the receiving bank; shareholder bank statements for the 6-to-12 month pre-funding period; signed capital contribution or shareholder-loan agreement; executed Banque de France cross-border declaration for amounts above EUR 50,000; supporting transfer advice quoting 'Apport – souscription au capital social'.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Airport bonded catering license and customs-enclosure operation flagged as a higher-risk licensed sector
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Airport authority concession or ramp-access permit; DGDDI customs bonded operator or aviation catering approval; valid airline supply contracts with flag carriers; daily meal-delivery and clean-seal logs; import declarations (ECX) and cargo manifests proving genuine commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative news, referrals or suspicion of circumventing EU restrictive measures through foreign airline counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Restricted client list limited to airlines cleared under EU sanctions screening; procedural letters confirming refusal of service to designated counterparties; transaction-level compliance opinions; periodic KYC refresh files and time-stamped screening results prepared for bank review.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing uses a SWIFT MT103 wire from the parent or investor bank into the SARL's French operational account, quoting purpose reference 'Apport – souscription au capital social'. For inbound amounts exceeding EUR 50,000, the receiving bank encodes the transaction in the Banque de France balance-of-payments file; amounts of EUR 150,000 or more in goods-related transfers trigger DGDDI goods declaration. The SARL must file the UBO declaration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés before first drawdown and, for non-EU investors, confirm in writing that the investment is not in an FDI-screened sector. Verification bundle for the bank: deposit certificate, share issuance resolution, investor identification, proof of funds covering the preceding six months and an anti-money laundering source-of-wealth statement; funds are then released to the operational account only after full KYC clearance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails comprise: (1) SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for domestic and EU supplier payments, monthly payroll and the European equivalent of the monthly ACH rail; (2) SWIFT MT103 for non-EU suppliers of raw materials and packaging; (3) commercial letters of credit (sight or usance) where large frozen or meat commodity imports require documentary checking and title protection; (4) TARGET2 for high-value same-day euro settlement between the SARL, airport authorities and airline counterparties; and (5) EBICS or bank-API connectivity delivering ISO 20022 camt statements for daily liquidity reconciliation and straight-through processing.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EUR/USD and EUR/GBP outright forwards under an ISDA or French Banking Federation (FBF) master agreement
FX swaps for temporary liquidity conversion between USD, GBP and EUR
European-style FX options with hedging purpose evidenced by airline invoice pipeline and catering purchase forecasts
Natural hedging through a multi-currency operational account to offset USD airline billings against USD food and packaging imports

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not standard for EUR since the euro is freely convertible; NDFs may only be considered back-to-back with an offshore parent where an invoice is denominated in a genuinely restricted currency

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts at the Ordinary General Meeting and filing of annual accounts (dépôt des comptes annuels) with the commercial register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Guichet Unique électronique / INPI – Registre National des Entreprises (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting within 6 months of fiscal-year end; accounts filed within 1 month following shareholder approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registrar formal notice; coercive fine (astreinte) ordered by the president of the commercial court for continued non-filing; criminal fine up to €9,000 on the gérant for failure to convene the meeting within 6 months (Art. L.241-10 Code de commerce); risk of judicial strike-off (radiation) from the RCS after persistent default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale / déclaration de résultats, form n°2065-SD) with fiscal annexes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – mandatory electronic filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 3 May of the year following the close for fiscal years ending 31 December; otherwise within 3 months after the fiscal-year close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty interest of 0.2% per month plus increase of the tax due: 10% for late filing without formal notice, 40% after formal notice (mise en demeure), 80% for fraudulent filing; fixed fine of €250 for missing mandatory annexes

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT final settlement / adjustment declaration (form CA12 / CA12E) under the simplified real VAT regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 3 May of the year following the close for fiscal years ending 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 10% / 40% / 80% on the VAT amount due plus 0.2% monthly late interest; loss of input VAT deduction rights for non-submitted correction declarations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation declaration of beneficial owners (confirmation annuelle des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days following the anniversary of the company's RCS registration date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: After a formal notice and 30-day regularization period, fine up to €15,000 per natural person and up to €75,000 per legal entity (Code monétaire et financier art. L.561-2-2); continued default may lead to judicial strike-off of the RCS registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE) – annual local business property contribution settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payment due by 15 December of the current tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 10% plus monthly interest of 0.2%; enforced recovery proceeding (avis de mise en recouvrement) by the public treasury

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) when, at fiscal-year end, it exceeds at least two of the three thresholds: total balance sheet ≥ €4,000,000; net turnover excluding VAT ≥ €8,000,000; average number of employees ≥ 50. Mandatory audit also applies to public-interest entities, group-controlled parent companies and subsidiaries of audited groups meeting the consolidation thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, ANC Règlement n°2014-03); IFRS permitted only for consolidated accounts of listed groups; individual statutory annual accounts must comply with French GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, within 30 days of the RCS registration anniversary, the SARL must e-file a confirmation declaration through the Guichet Unique certifying that the beneficial owners recorded at the RNE remain accurate, or, if any change occurred, submitting an updated declaration indicating the exact percentage of capital or voting rights and the nature of the control held by each beneficial owner (Code monétaire et financier art. L.561-2-2).
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des mouvements de titres (share and ownership transfer register)
Registre des délibérations et assemblées (minutes of shareholders' meetings and gérant decisions)
Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (UBO register kept at the registered office)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: EUR 120–EUR 300 per annum (approx. USD 130–USD 330) for professional registered-office and corporate secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: EUR 3,000–EUR 15,000 per annum (approx. USD 3,300–USD 16,300) for a statutory audit, depending on turnover, group consolidation requirements and internal control readiness

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard corporate income tax percentage for fiscal years closing on or after 1 January 2022; prior years at 26.5%/28%).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% headline on the first tranche of taxable income up to EUR 42,500 per financial year (SARL qualifying as a 'petite entreprise' — revenue below EUR 10 million, capital held at least 75% by individuals). Preferential regimes that materially lower the effective rate: Patents/Intellectual Property regime (10% tax on net IP income), Crédit d'Impôt Recherche (CIR) at 30%/5% for R&D expenditure, Crédit d'Impôt Innovation (CII) at 20% capped on eligible innovation costs, and the elimination of the former duration and surcharge contributions; exemption (100%) under the Parent-Subsidiary participation regime for qualifying dividends (option Mère-Fille) in the consolidated tax account.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward (indefinite) subject to an annual cap of EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding that threshold; separate 5-year full-offset option exists only for companies under safeguard, conciliation, or judicial reorganisation procedure.
